integrity: The analytical derivation is provided with an independent finite-N quadrature and limiting-integral checker. The checker is diagnostic, not a certification of the infinite limit. Full external independent review and global publication-priority verification have not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Fixed positive rates and diffusion, two distinct positive trap stiffnesses, one-dimensional stationary signed-position maximum, conditional independent noises. No hydrodynamic coupling or finite-sample estimation guarantees; no uniform coalescent-stiffness or zero-rate limits. The exact Gaussian mixture is sourced prior work. The new contribution is its nonuniform two-edge asymptotic and conditional localization.
title: Two-sided Gumbel boundary layers and asymmetric finite-size leakage in a switching harmonic gas
